name: Dissolving sodium bicarbonate in water

time_constant_s.source: teaching-pace timescale, not a measured rate

observations.started: The white crystals begin to dissolve.
observations.saturated: No more sodium bicarbonate dissolves: the solution is saturated and crystals remain at the bottom.
observations.completed: All the sodium bicarbonate has dissolved. The solution stays colourless.

explanation: Water molecules separate the ions in the crystal and spread them through the liquid.
